newsitem.title: UK: British youth visits Iran, drafted into army.
newsitem.headline: British youth visits Iran, drafted into army.

text.p: A British schoolboy has been drafted into the Iranian army for national service of up to two years after visiting the country on holiday, his mother said on Friday.
Reza Afshar, 17, who was born in Britain of Iranian parents, accompanied his sister Sara and mother Farideh on a trip to see relatives.
When he got there, Iranian officials told him that conscription laws which had previously meant he was immune from army draft until he was 18 had changed.
His mother said there was nothing British diplomats could do to get her son back because he had travelled on an Iranian passport.
"I am so worried. I just want to get him out and that is my main concern," she told Britain's Press Association news agency.
